name: 85607 · Douglas, AZ
findings: ZIP 85607 (Douglas) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85607 (Douglas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85607 (Douglas) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
